01 / About me

Engineering with curiosity.

Hi, I'm Mohammad.

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Systems Engineering at Humber Polytechnic. I enjoy the intersection of programming and physical systems: writing code, integrating components, troubleshooting unexpected problems, and seeing a project come to life.

My work includes robotics, embedded computing, relational databases, and software projects. I am currently building my knowledge in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud technologies, and data analytics.

I'm looking for an opportunity to contribute to a technical team, learn from engineers and developers, and build technology that makes a difference.

MechaBeest

DIY Mechanical Clock

Designed and built a wooden mechanical clock from scratch as a first-semester engineering project. Calculated gear ratios, drafted components in AutoCAD, assembled each gear by hand, and troubleshot the mechanism until it ran smoothly.
